description: This file implements the MediaKeysCapabilities class and related factory functions for managing media key system support, including querying supported key systems, checking support for specific key systems, and retrieving version information. It also includes utility functions for converting error statuses to strings.

classes.name: MediaKeysCapabilities
classes.description: Implements media key system support querying, including supported key systems, support checks, and version retrieval.

classes.name: IMediaKeysCapabilitiesFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating MediaKeysCapabilities instances.

classes.description: Concrete factory class for creating MediaKeysCapabilities instances.

methods.name: getSupportedKeySystemVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the version of a supported key system.
